_provenance: Reference simulator Game-P2P-Cop-Chase (rmisegal), read 2026-07-31 via the lecturer's published NotebookLM. Real match output produced by the reference implementation, not a value this project invented.
_why: The vectors under shared_contract/ are self-authored: this project chose the payloads and computed the expected hashes. They prove the Cop runtime and the neutral stub agree with each other, but they cannot prove either agrees with an outside implementation. This record was produced by different code on a different machine, so it closes that gap. It also exercises float rendering (ram_gb 31.8, vram_gb 6.0), the classic cross-language canonicalization hazard.
